decisions.locator: Effect +04 Timer; +06 Interval; S32: docs/S32_ST_TIMING_RESEARCH.md; tools/probe_s32_st_timing.py; tests/fixtures/s32_st_timing_results.json
decisions.finding: Calendar and effect countdowns reload 240 ($1654/$2446); accelerated flag bypasses both. One raw timer unit has one game-minute steady-state period. Successful casting resets shared effect phase to 1 ($0b8c). Unsigned timer/interval words are 0..65535; initial zero is dormant, interval zero disarms after current execution. Missed scheduler polls lose updates in the candidate.
decisions.unknown: Full hardware/service emulation is not claimed. Original shared phase and polling loss are intentionally not reproduced.
decisions.disposition: User decision 2026-11-20 preserves all elapsed time: activation-relative integer game-microsecond deadlines; 60,000,000 units per positive raw timer unit. Zero remains dormant, not immediate. S30 implements and tests this bounded contract; see docs/S30_ACCEPTANCE_REVIEW.md and tests/test_effect_timing.gd.

decisions.finding: On expiry: reload interval, finish incubation/show linked text, check cure, execute action, decrement finite counter, then remove at exhaustion ($2476..2528). Counter zero does not expire by execution. Removed later due slots are skipped; root removal clears its linked group.
decisions.unknown: Complete natural-cure random-stream behavior remains outside this slice.
decisions.disposition: Bounded order resolved by S32 original-code probes. Reject nonzero cure. Removal performs no inverse arithmetic. S30 implements and tests this bounded contract; see docs/S30_ACCEPTANCE_REVIEW.md and tests/test_effect_timing.gd.
